article.story: SANTA CLARA, Calif. -- — Jake Ensminger had 15 points in Santa Clara’s 95-72 win against Milwaukee on Wednesday. Ensminger also contributed seven rebounds for the Broncos (2-0). David Castillo scored 13 points and added three steals. Brad Longcor III finished with 11 points. Aaron Womack led the Panthers (0-2) with 14 points and three blocks. Dylan Omweno added 12 points for Milwaukee. Al Amadou finished with 11 points. Santa Clara took the lead for good with 19:41 remaining in the first half. The score was 46-27 at halftime, with Ensminger racking up nine points. Castillo led the way in the second half with nine points. Up next Up next for Santa Clara is a Saturday matchup with Sacramento State at home, and Milwaukee hosts Ripon on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
